question: Which of the following national waterways has been **INCORRECTLY **matched with its associated river?
solution: The correct answer is __**National Waterway 6 - Sutlej**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • National Waterways 6 is a **71 km** waterway between **Lakhipur and Bhanga** of the **Barak River**. • The NW - 6 passes through **Assam, Nagaland, Mizoram, Manipur, Tripura, and Arunachal Pradesh**.
